name: rolling-chorus-banish-two-total-reserve-twenty-draws-into-memory
notes: Rolling Chorus (IZVXDYjcSL): banishing Season's End (reserve 10) and Argus (reserve 10) from your graveyard totals 20 >= 15, so a card is drawn into memory. Pre-fix the handler died with an undefined-function fatal (CardReserveCost).

rulesClauses: Banish up to two target cards from a single graveyard. If the total reserve cost of the banished cards is 15 or greater, draw a card into your memory.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. RollingChorusBanishAndDraw() (Custom/GameLogic.php) summed the banished cards' reserve costs with CardReserveCost(), which does not exist in GrandArchiveSim (the dictionary accessor is CardCost_reserve()): after the two graveyard cards were chosen the ability died with a fatal 'Call to undefined function CardReserveCost()' and nothing was banished or drawn. It now uses CardCost_reserve().
